channels.channel: band_01_mag_anom - Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field
band_02_rtp - Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects
band_03_tmi_hg - Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction
band_04_geod_2ndinv - Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude
band_05_iso_grav_anom_slope - Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
band_06_tc - Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
band_07_geod_shearrate - Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR
band_08_geod_dilaterate - Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)
band_09_tmi_vg - Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction
band_10_deq_n100a15 - Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15° azimuth parameters)
band_11_iso_grav_anom_vg - Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
band_12_det_elev - Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed
band_13_iso_grav_anom - Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass
band_14_tmi - Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field
band_15_depth_to_base_surf - Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover
band_16_ieq_n100a15 - Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15° parameters)
band_17_cond_surf - Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface
band_18_iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change
band_19_det_elev_slope - Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending
